index.html.summary: KYS.Library.Excel Documentation Welcome to KYS.Library.Excel, an add-on to KYS.Library for generating Excel workbooks in internal .NET applications. It turns a DataTable or DataSet into an .xlsx file (as a byte[]), with optional column formatting, header and summary row styling, and additional worksheets. This site contains a high-level overview of the library and a full API reference automatically generated from XML documentation comments. 📦 Project Modules KYS.Library.Excel Contains the options and models used to customize the generated workbook: ExcelColumnFormat – selects, renames, formats, aligns, and sums columns. ExcelRowStyle – styles a whole row (alignment, bold, font/background color, fill pattern, auto filter). Ships with DefaultHeaderRowStyle and DefaultSummaryRowStyle. AdditionalExcelSheet – describes an extra worksheet (data, column formats, header and summary styles). KYS.Library.Excel.Helpers Includes the helper classes that build the workbook: ExcelHelper – CreateExcelBook from a DataTable or DataSet (one worksheet per table). ExcelDataTableHelper – WriteToExcelFile shortcut for a single DataTable. All methods return a Result<byte[]> (CSharpFunctionalExtensions) instead of throwing. ⚡ Quick Example using KYS.Library.Excel.Helpers; using KYS.Library.Excel.Options; using OfficeOpenXml; // Required once at application startup (see license note below) ExcelPackage.LicenseContext = LicenseContext.NonCommercial; Result<byte[]> excel = ExcelHelper.CreateExcelBook( dataTable, excelColumnFormats: new List<ExcelColumnFormat> { new() { ColumnName = "Name", DisplayedColumnName = "Student Name" }, new() { ColumnName = "Score", Format = "#,##0.00", HasSumColumn = true } }, headerRowStyle: ExcelRowStyle.DefaultHeaderRowStyle, summaryRowStyle: ExcelRowStyle.DefaultSummaryRowStyle); if (excel.IsSuccess) File.WriteAllBytes("report.xlsx", excel.Value); ⚠️ Third-party License This library is built on EPPlus 6, which is licensed under PolyForm Noncommercial. A commercial license is required for commercial use. The consuming application must set the EPPlus license context before calling any helper. This library does not set it: ExcelPackage.LicenseContext = LicenseContext.NonCommercial; // or LicenseContext.Commercial 🚀 Using This Library (Internal Use) Since this library is not currently published to NuGet, it can be consumed by: Cloning or downloading the repository Building the solution Locating the generated DLLs under: KYS.Library.Excel/bin/Debug/net8.0/ or KYS.Library.Excel/bin/Release/net8.0/ Adding the DLL references to your project manually (KYS.Library.Excel depends on KYS.Library, so reference both): In Visual Studio: Project → Add Reference → Browse → Select DLLs In .NET CLI-based project: <ItemGroup> <Reference Include="KYS.Library"> <HintPath>path/to/KYS.Library.dll</HintPath> </Reference> <Reference Include="KYS.Library.Excel"> <HintPath>path/to/KYS.Library.Excel.dll</HintPath> </Reference> </ItemGroup> Adding the third-party NuGet packages used by the library: EPPlus and CSharpFunctionalExtensions. 📘 API Reference Detailed class, method, and property documentation is available under the API section of this site. All content is generated automatically based on XML documentation comments in the source code. 📂 Project Structure KYS.Library.Excel/ ├── Helpers/ ├── Models/ └── Options/ (Classes and namespaces inside each module can be viewed through the API reference.) 🛠 Documentation This documentation is generated using DocFX and will stay updated as new XML comments are added or modified.
